facts.fact: The Information and Communications Act, 2009 (No. 2 of 2009) entered into force on 29 May 2009 and carries Part III of Chapter III, 'Computer Misuse and Cyber Crime', creating offences such as unauthorised access to computer data (fine of 200,000 dalasis or up to five years' imprisonment, or both).
The Gambia Press Union cited the Cybercrime Bill 2023 as pending legislation with broad surveillance powers, heavy fines and prison terms.
The Minister of Communications and Digital Economy says the Cyber Crime Bill is being finalised and has been presented to the National Assembly for enactment.
CIVICUS Monitor reports that in March 2024 the National Assembly of The Gambia reintroduced the proposed 2023 Cybercrime Bill for adoption.
